## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run lint:prose`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Playwright spec, if a flow or layout changed

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to the linked issue.
- [ ] New logic has a regression test.
- [ ] Both Indonesian and English strings were added when needed.
- [ ] Light, dark, high contrast, and 200 percent font size were considered.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, and success states were considered.
- [ ] No secrets, real receipts, or transaction data are included.
- [ ] Storage, security, or operations docs were updated when behavior changed.
